threat_model: T1 candidate; not a T2 sandbox

request.owner: nonempty deployment UUID; not ownership authority
request.host_binding: 64 lowercase hex content reference; future authenticated local binding absent
request.inventory_hash: 64 lowercase hex, UTC freshness window <= 5 minutes
request.identities: distinct client/broker/UI local-account SID shapes, client+broker same machine prefix; new-local-origin must be proved later
request.client_endpoint: literal 127.0.0.1, explicit uint16 port > 0, TCP only
request.broker_endpoint: explicit canonical unicast IPv4 + uint16 TCP port, remote authentication not inferred

filter_objects.flags: PERSISTENT only; no dynamic session, boot or clear-action-right flags
role_predicates: IPv4: SID AND TCP AND remote address != exact endpoint
IPv4: SID AND TCP AND remote address == endpoint AND remote port != exact port
filter_objects.selected_edge: unmatched by own denies, not an explicit permit or availability proof
filter_objects.ALE_USER_ID: FWP_SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE with self-relative exact-SID DACL / FWP_ACTRL_MATCH_FILTER
filter_objects.arbitration: foreign filters/callouts/hard permits remain UNVERIFIED; no weight heuristic establishes OS precedence

native_boundary.not_claimed: not a sandbox against reflection or a privileged actor intentionally loading internal source

future_order: stop owned process trees and delegated work
verify exact trusted ownership and live readback
remove owned deny objects last, within reviewed transaction
remove exact owned provider/sublayer only after filter ownership/references verified
